categories.startByAsking: Startup ke dauran symptom kis stage par rukta hai: logo, boot animation, lock screen ya home screen.
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Phone ko charge par stable rakhein; exact screen/error aur restart pattern note karein. Agar lock screen tak pahunchta hai, recent app/update aur free storage check karein.
categories.automationBoundary: Safe Mode sirf OEM ke documented button method se; recovery menu mein Wipe data/Factory reset select na karein. Bootloader unlock/firmware flash end-user AI flow ka hissa nahi.
categories.verification: Boot completes repeatedly, restart loop stops, and normal unlock/home screen works.
categories.stopEscalate: Repeated boot loop, recovery-only state, update ke baad boot failure, ya physical/power symptoms: data-preserving authorised service diagnosis.

categories.startByAsking: Lag global hai ya sirf ek app mein? Kab se, kitni storage free, phone garam hai, aur recent update/app kya tha?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings > Storage mein free space dekhein; Settings > Battery/Battery usage mein top consumers; recent apps/update note karein; phone cool hone dein. Ek waqt mein ek change.
categories.automationBoundary: Unneeded user apps close/uninstall only with consent; selected app ka cache clear karna user-guided. Third-party app doosri apps ka cache/data universally clear nahi kar sakti.
categories.verification: Same task pehle aur baad mein compare; app launch, scrolling, typing aur idle responsiveness retest.
categories.stopEscalate: Safe Mode mein bhi severe lag, storage read/write errors, abnormal heat, repeated shutdown: service inspection.

categories.startByAsking: User se poochhein kaunsa behaviour badla aur desired setting kya hai; setting accidentally ON hui ya feature broken hai?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings search mein feature ka exact naam search; current state screenshot/note; related Display, Accessibility, Home screen, Sound ya System menu inspect.
categories.automationBoundary: Most global settings silently change nahi ki ja sakti. Settings page kholna ya guided user toggle; Accessibility/special access user ko khud enable/disable karna hoga.
categories.verification: Setting desired state mein hai aur user wahi action repeat karke confirm karta hai.
categories.stopEscalate: Option missing due managed profile/policy, physical key/sensor issue, ya setting toggle wapas badalta rahe: OEM/admin support.

categories.startByAsking: App ka naam, version, exact error, kab crash hota hai, aur kya doosri apps bhi fail hoti hain?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Play Store se app update; device restart; Settings > Apps > [app] > Force stop (user action); Storage > Clear cache; permissions aur network test.
categories.automationBoundary: AI app ko universal cross-app force-stop/clear-cache rights nahi. Clear storage/data, uninstall, logout ya reinstall se pehle data/login loss explain and explicit consent.
categories.verification: App cold-open, login, primary feature and one normal task retest; server-side error alag note.
categories.stopEscalate: Multiple apps fail/system component crash, account lock/security warning, or app backend outage: appropriate app support/OEM.

categories.startByAsking: Drain/charging symptom kab hota hai: idle, gaming, charging, after update? Battery percentage and temperature warning?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings > Battery > Battery usage; top app/process identify; update apps; restart; compare normal use; known-good compatible charger/cable and outlet.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not claim battery health from percentage alone. AI can explain battery stats; protected power settings may require user action.
categories.verification: Observe over a normal usage period; compare drain pattern and charging indicator with known-good accessories.
categories.stopEscalate: Swelling, unusual heat, smell, sudden shutdown, damaged port: stop charging/use if unsafe and seek service urgently.

categories.startByAsking: Storage kis category mein bhar rahi hai—photos/videos, downloads, apps, system, cache? Kya SD card involved hai?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings > Storage category inspect; review Downloads and large media; backup important files before deleting; clear cache for selected apps.
categories.automationBoundary: Never delete Android/system folders or unknown files. No automatic user-file deletion. Clear data/format SD card only after backup and explicit confirmation.
categories.verification: Free-space number increases; target install/save/record task works; files remain accessible.
categories.stopEscalate: SD card repeatedly unreadable/read-only, storage errors, files corrupt across apps: stop writes and seek recovery/service.

categories.startByAsking: Issue Wi-Fi, mobile data, one app, or all internet? Same network par doosra device works? Error and location?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Compare another device; toggle airplane mode/Wi-Fi; test browser and another app; check data saver/background data, VPN/Private DNS, APN only with carrier settings.
categories.automationBoundary: AI can open network settings and guide; cannot bypass carrier provisioning or silently change all protected network configs. Forget network requires password; reset network removes saved pairings.
categories.verification: Open a known website and affected app; compare Wi-Fi vs mobile data.
categories.stopEscalate: Multiple known-good SIMs/networks fail, SIM/port damage or area outage: carrier/OEM support.

categories.startByAsking: Issue whole screen or one app? Same area? After drop/water/protector? Brightness/rotation/zoom?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Clean/dry screen; remove case/protector temporarily; restart; check rotation, brightness, magnification, colour correction, display size and overlay permission.
categories.automationBoundary: AI cannot repair a damaged panel or force protected display calibration. Guide the user through visible settings only.
categories.verification: Test same screen area and rotation in Settings plus another app.
categories.stopEscalate: Same physical region consistently fails, flicker after impact, cracks/liquid: suspected hardware, service inspection.

categories.startByAsking: Media, ringtone, call, mic, or one app? Bluetooth/headphones connected? Does recorder work?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check each volume slider and DND; disconnect Bluetooth; select phone speaker; test voice recorder and a second app; inspect app mic permission.
categories.automationBoundary: Microphone/camera permissions require user consent. AI cannot infer hardware failure from one app test.
categories.verification: Play known audio and record/playback a short test in two apps.
categories.stopEscalate: Fails across apps with no Bluetooth route or after physical/liquid damage: service.

categories.startByAsking: Which app and notification type? Missing or delayed? Is app open? Does notification appear in app itself?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings > Notifications > App notifications > target app; inspect categories, lock screen, DND, silent mode; app internal notification settings; background data.
categories.automationBoundary: Protected notification settings may need user action. Do not request Notification Listener unless core feature truly needs it and user understands access.
categories.verification: Send a fresh test notification; check both app inbox and system shade.
categories.stopEscalate: Only one service fails while settings are correct: app/server support; all apps fail: system notification diagnosis.

categories.startByAsking: Which game, device temperature, graphics/FPS preset, network, and does issue occur outside game?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Update game via official store; check resources/storage; restart; cool device; temporarily compare with recorder/overlays off; test Wi-Fi vs mobile data; use supported graphics preset.
categories.automationBoundary: No FPS unlock, anti-cheat bypass, game file modification or hidden tweak. AI cannot guarantee zero lag or change game internals.
categories.verification: Repeat same map/mode for short controlled test; note FPS/ping symptoms separately.
categories.stopEscalate: Persistent heat, touch/gyro failure in diagnostics, device shutdown, server-side errors: OEM/game support.

categories.startByAsking: Device type, pairing state, error, distance, and does it connect to another phone?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Charge both devices; toggle Bluetooth; restart both; forget and pair again only if user can re-pair; check Nearby devices permission and accessory instructions.
categories.automationBoundary: Network reset may erase saved Wi-Fi/Bluetooth; ask before. No silent pairing or bypassing pairing/security.
categories.verification: Reconnect and test audio/data/health sync as relevant.
categories.stopEscalate: Accessory fails with multiple phones or phone Bluetooth fails with multiple known-good devices: service/accessory support.

categories.startByAsking: What exact warning or access occurred? Which app, when, and did user install it intentionally?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Do not tap suspicious pop-ups. Inspect app source, permissions, Play Protect status, recent installs and notification source; update from official sources.
categories.automationBoundary: Never disable Play Protect, bypass lock/security, grant Accessibility/Device Admin to unknown apps, or install unknown APKs. Sensitive action requires clear consent.
categories.verification: Remove/revoke only clearly unwanted app access after user confirmation; verify warning/source stops.
categories.stopEscalate: Suspected malware, financial/account compromise, persistent unknown admin/profile: disconnect risky access and seek trusted security/OEM support.

categories.startByAsking: Which update (Android, security patch, Play system, app, WebView) and exact stage/error?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check Settings > System/Software update and storage; stable Wi-Fi and sufficient charge; restart; retry official updater; check OEM status.
categories.automationBoundary: Never flash unofficial firmware, unlock bootloader, sideload unknown packages or force downgrade. Factory reset is not first-line.
categories.verification: Confirm installed version/build and retest the original symptom.
categories.stopEscalate: Repeated OTA failure/boot issue: OEM support; preserve data and avoid repeated forced attempts.

categories.startByAsking: Which Google service fails and which account? Is sign-in blocked, sync paused, or only one data type missing?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check internet/date-time; Settings > Passwords & accounts/Accounts > Google > Account sync; inspect service status and storage quota; update Google apps.
categories.automationBoundary: Never ask for password/OTP/recovery codes. Do not remove account without warning about unsynced data and explicit confirmation.
categories.verification: Check sync timestamp and target data on trusted web/device if user has access.
categories.stopEscalate: Account security challenge/lock or suspected compromise: official Google account recovery only.

categories.startByAsking: Which keyboard, language/layout, only one app or all apps? Does another keyboard work?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Settings > System/Additional settings > Keyboard & input method; confirm default and languages; update keyboard; restart; inspect microphone permission for voice typing.
categories.automationBoundary: Never read or store typed passwords/messages. Clipboard access is sensitive; do not collect clipboard content.
categories.verification: Test typing in a neutral text field and switch languages once.
categories.stopEscalate: Touchscreen-specific missed keys across keyboards or mic hardware failure: service.

categories.startByAsking: Which accessibility feature is active and what does user want? Can they navigate with spoken feedback?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Use feature-specific toggle path and OEM help; TalkBack navigation uses focus then double-tap activation; volume-key shortcut may toggle only if configured.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not disable accessibility service blindly: may be assistive technology the user relies on. Ask what support they need first.
categories.verification: User can navigate comfortably and intended assistive features remain enabled.
categories.stopEscalate: If user cannot navigate safely, provide trusted person/OEM accessibility support; do not rush toggles.

categories.startByAsking: Camera or media app? Front/rear, photo/video, one app/all apps? Storage and permission?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Close camera-using apps; check camera/mic permission; restart; update app/system; verify free storage; test built-in camera and another trusted app.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not clear Gallery/Media Storage data or delete media as first step. Permissions are user-controlled.
categories.verification: Take a test photo/video and verify it saves and plays with audio.
categories.stopEscalate: Camera unavailable across apps, lens damage, focus failure after impact: service.

categories.startByAsking: Which app and sensor/location? Indoor/outdoor? Does issue affect all apps or one?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Enable location and precise access as needed; check app permission/background access; test outdoors with clear sky; remove magnetic case/accessory; restart.
categories.automationBoundary: Location is sensitive personal data. Request only while feature is used; do not continuously track or upload.
categories.verification: Compare location in trusted map and affected app; rotate device for compass test.
categories.stopEscalate: Sensor missing across multiple apps/diagnostics or after impact: hardware inspection.

categories.startByAsking: Incoming/outgoing, calls/SMS, one contact/network, or dialer UI? Is SIM service active?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check signal/SIM, DND, Phone app notifications/default app, permissions, app update; test call/SMS with trusted contact.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not read message contents or call logs unless essential and explicit consent. Do not change emergency calling configuration.
categories.verification: Place/receive a normal test call and send/receive test SMS if available.
categories.stopEscalate: Carrier registration/VoLTE outage, SIM/antenna fault or dialer crash across reboots: carrier/OEM.

categories.startByAsking: Play Store or another installer? Exact error code, app, free storage, Android version?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check internet/date-time/storage; cancel stuck download; restart; update Play Store/Play Services; check app compatibility and official store status.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not bypass parental/work controls or install unknown APKs. Clearing Play Store data may reset local store settings; explain first.
categories.verification: Install/update a small trusted app and verify version.
categories.stopEscalate: Store account/payment verification or managed-device block: official store/admin support.

categories.startByAsking: Launcher brand, blank home vs missing icons/widgets, does app drawer/recent apps work?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Restart; Settings > Apps > Default apps > Home app; select intended launcher; update launcher; check widgets/provider app.
categories.automationBoundary: Clear launcher storage can erase home-screen layout; never do without backup/explicit confirmation.
categories.verification: Home screen, app drawer, widgets and navigation reopen normally after restart.
categories.stopEscalate: System UI/launcher crashes across safe mode or display touch faults: OEM.

categories.startByAsking: What data is missing, backup source/date/account, and is old phone still available?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Check backup timestamp/account/quota; confirm old device still holds data; sync contacts/photos separately; export critical files where supported.
categories.automationBoundary: No reset/erase until backup verified and user confirms. Do not promise every app data can be restored.
categories.verification: Open restored files/contacts and compare counts/sample items with source.
categories.stopEscalate: Missing irreplaceable data or failing storage: stop writes and seek professional recovery.

categories.startByAsking: Exact system component/error and what triggers it? One app or system-wide?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Record exact error; restart; update affected component from Play Store/system updater; test safe mode if appropriate; check storage.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not use root, shell commands, package disabling, system-file deletion or unofficial APKs.
categories.verification: Repeat the trigger and confirm component version/state.
categories.stopEscalate: System process repeatedly crashes or boot stability affected: OEM support.

categories.startByAsking: Which developer option changed and what was original/default? What problem started after change?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Record current value; explain the option; restore only known changed value to default; turn off USB debugging if user does not need it.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not change random options, force GPU, process limits, OEM unlock or wireless debugging as a generic speed fix.
categories.verification: Restart if needed and compare original task; ensure intended developer workflow still works.
categories.stopEscalate: ADB/bootloader/firmware state confusion: advanced authorised technician; no bypass instructions.

categories.categoryName: SIM Card & Mobile Network Configuration Problems
categories.startByAsking: Single/dual SIM, carrier, location, exact status text, does SIM work in another phone?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Toggle airplane mode; confirm correct SIM for calls/data; check carrier outage; use carrier-provided APN; test SIM in compatible phone if possible.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not invent APN values or force unsupported bands. Carrier provisioning requires carrier.
categories.verification: Check registration, call and data on selected SIM.
categories.stopEscalate: SIM not detected across devices or multiple known-good SIMs fail in phone: carrier/OEM inspection.

categories.categoryName: Thermal Management & System Overheating Software Problems
categories.startByAsking: When hot—charging, gaming, sunlight, idle? Any warning, swelling, smell, shutdown?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Stop heavy workload; unplug if unusually hot; move out of sun; let cool naturally on hard surface; never fridge/freezer/water; after cool inspect battery usage.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not run stress tests or keep charging a hot/swollen device. No app can cool hardware or override thermal protection.
categories.verification: Only resume normal light use when cooled; monitor whether heat returns at idle.
categories.stopEscalate: Swelling, smell, smoke, extreme/repeated heat or shutdown: stop use/charging and seek urgent qualified service.

categories.startByAsking: Phone-to-PC, OTG, tethering or file transfer? Cable supports data? Which USB mode prompt?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Use known-good data cable/port; unlock phone; select File Transfer when prompt appears; test another computer/accessory; inspect visible port only.
categories.automationBoundary: Do not insert metal or liquid/cleaner into port. USB debugging is not required for ordinary file transfer.
categories.verification: Transfer a harmless test file both directions.
categories.stopEscalate: Loose/damaged port, heat, bent pins or failures with known-good cable/PC: service.

categories.startByAsking: Is device managed by employer/school/parent? Exact restriction message? Who owns/administers device?
categories.readOnlyChecksAndFirstLinePath: Identify administrator; check Settings > Security/Privacy > Device admin/Work profile; contact owner/admin for authorised change.
categories.automationBoundary: Never bypass FRP, screen lock, parental controls, work management or account verification. Do not remove admin profile without owner approval.
categories.verification: Admin confirms setting/policy changed through authorised channel.
categories.stopEscalate: Unknown management profile or suspected unauthorised control: trusted OEM/admin/security support.
